Package index

Mapping

Map SDTM domains into the CTAS long-format vocabulary.

Standardize_Domain()
Rename an SDTM findings domain into the CTAS long-format vocabulary
Standardize_Queries()
Standardise an EDC query frame into the CTAS + ctasapp vocabulary
Transform_Missing()
Convert findings to a running missing-ratio timeseries for CTAS
Transform_OneHot()
One-hot encode a categorical findings frame for CTAS
Transform_Range()
Normalise reference-bounded numeric findings for CTAS

Analysis

Run CTAS and emit the ctasapp-shaped output frames.

Analyze_CTAS()
Score sites with CTAS

Reporting

Bind the ctasapp output frames and write them to disk for the ctasapp dashboard.

BindResults_CTAS()
Bind one named shard across metric workflow outputs
Write_ctasapp()
Write ctasapp shards to disk

Summary

Aggregate CTAS results into a gsm-shaped summary + metric + group meta for the CTAS site report.

Summarize_CTAS()
Aggregate CTAS site scores into a gsm-shaped CTAS summary
Flag_CTAS()
Flag CTAS scores with a gsm-shaped Flag column
MakeMetric_CTAS()
Build the CTAS gsm-shaped dfMetrics audit table
Report_CTAS()
Render the CTAS site-level report from a CTAS summary
